mapper.sql: id, user_id as userId, product_id as productId, sku_id as skuId, specs, quantity, selected, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, sku_id, specs, quantity, selected, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{specs}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.product_id as productId, c.sku_id as skuId, c.specs, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName, IFNULL(sku.price, p.price) as productPrice, p.cover_img as productImg, p.merchant_id as merchantId, m.shop_name as merchantName FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON c.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.product_id as productId, c.sku_id as skuId, c.specs, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName, IFNULL(sku.price, p.price) as productPrice, p.cover_img as productImg, p.merchant_id as merchantId, m.shop_name as merchantName FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON c.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId} AND ((c.sku_id = #{skuId}) OR (c.sku_id IS NULL AND #{skuId} IS NULL))

SELECT c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.product_id as productId, c.sku_id as skuId, c.specs, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime, p.name as productName, IFNULL(sku.price, p.price) as productPrice, p.cover_img as productImg, p.merchant_id as merchantId, m.shop_name as merchantName FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON c.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}
